title: 9Y9P
description: 9Y9P offers a native vanilla environment on v1.21.4, powered by EPYC 9575F for lag-free, 16-chunk performance. We are 100% non-profit with zero donations, kits, or queues, ensuring a completely equal playing field for every player.
body:
Looking for a true 2b2t-style experience without the 12-hour queue or laggy hardware? Welcome to 9Y9P.
IP: 9y9p.com
Version: 1.21.4 (Always synced with 2b2t.org)
Discord: dc.9y9p.com

Why Play on 9Y9P?
Absolute Performance: Powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F, 576GB RAM, and 144TB Storage. We offer a smooth 16-chunk view distance outside of spawn.
Massive World: Running for 10+ months with a 15TB+ world size. Explore nearly a year of history, griefs, and builds.
Zero Pay-to-Win: 100% Non-profit. We do NOT accept any kind of donations. No ranks, no kits, no priority queue, and no /tpa or /sethome. Everyone is equal.
True Anarchy: Hacked clients are allowed. No world resets.
Technical Friendly: Large-scale technical builds (TMC) and massive redstone contraptions are fully supported and welcomed.
Global Connectivity: Optimized network routes for players worldwide.

Server Stats

Peak Online: 80+ Players Daily
Hardware: EPYC 9575F + 576G RAM
Queue: NO QUEUE (Capacity for 1000+ players)
Dupe History: Clean (No major dupe exploits occurred yet)
Mode: Online Mode

Our Philosophy
9Y9P is a clone of 2b2t in terms of gameplay but a beast in terms of performance. We focus on the Native Vanilla Experience. We don't sell privileges because we believe anarchy should be free from the influence of money.
Join us today and leave your mark on the history!
